//: SYMPOSIUM IDE — VSCodium product.json branding overrides (Visionary Sparks).
//_HOW_IT_MERGES: apply-branding.ps1 deep-merges these keys into the VSCodium repo-root ./product.json. VSCodium's prepare_vscode.sh then runs `jq -s '.[0] * .[1]' vscode/product.json ../product.json`, so THESE keys win over both upstream VS Code and VSCodium defaults. Do NOT add `extensionsGallery` here — prepare_vscode.sh sets OpenVSX itself; overriding it would break the marketplace.
//nameShort: Short product name. Drives APP_NAME in the build scripts, the .exe/.msi/.zip filenames, the app folder name, Start-menu label, and the taskbar title.
//nameLong: Full product name shown in About dialog, window title suffix, and installer welcome text.
//applicationName: The CLI binary / executable base name (symposium.exe, and the `symposium` command on PATH). Lowercase, no spaces.
//serverApplicationName: Name of the remote/server (REH) binary. Only relevant if you build the Remote Extension Host; harmless to set.
//serverDataFolderName: Home-dir folder the remote server uses on a target host (~/.symposium-server).
//dataFolderName: Per-user data dir for CLI-installed extensions etc. (~/.symposium). Keep the leading dot.
//win32AppUserModelId: Windows AppUserModelID — groups taskbar windows & jump lists under one identity. Reverse-ish dotted id, no spaces.
//win32MutexName: Single-instance mutex name. Must be unique vs. VS Code / VSCodium so instances don't collide. Lowercase, no spaces.
//win32DirName: Default install directory leaf (e.g. C:\Program Files\Symposium IDE).
//win32NameVersion: Display name used in Windows 'Apps & features' / uninstall registry (version appended by installer).
//win32RegValueName: Registry value/key leaf under HKCU/HKLM Software for install metadata & file associations. No spaces.
//win32ShellNameShort: Text for the Explorer right-click 'Open with Symposium IDE' context-menu entries.
//win32Tunnel*: Mutex names for the tunnel/remote CLI. Set for uniqueness even though tunnels are unused; safe to keep.
//darwinBundleIdentifier: macOS CFBundleIdentifier for the .app (only used if you ever build the mac target).
//urlProtocol: Custom URI scheme the app registers (symposium://...). Used for deep links / OAuth callbacks into the IDE.
//reportIssueUrl: Where the built-in 'Report Issue' command sends users. Point at the public Symposium repo issues.
//licenseName: SPDX license id shown in About / installer. The wrapper (this rebrand) and VSCodium are MIT.
//licenseUrl: Link to the license text. Replace with the actual LICENSE path in the public Symposium repo.
//_LEAVE_UNSET: Do not set: extensionsGallery (OpenVSX handled by prepare_vscode.sh), quality, commit, date, checksums, updateUrl (self-updates need infra you don't have — leave off so the IDE stays offline/manual-update).
//_OPENVSX_NOTE: The built IDE's Extensions view talks to https://open-vsx.org (Eclipse Open VSX), NOT the Microsoft Marketplace (Microsoft's ToS forbid non-VS-Code clients using it). Fewer/older extensions than VS Marketplace, but legally clean and already wired by VSCodium.
